import ast, json, runpy, tomllib
from pathlib import Path
select = runpy.run_path("scripts/grid01_gpu.py")["select_worker_gpu"]
assert select("0, Tesla T4, GPU-synthetic-0, 15360 MiB, 535.0\n")["name"] == "Tesla T4"
try:
    select("0, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Ti, GPU-synthetic-0, 12288 MiB, 535.0\n")
except ValueError as exc:
    assert str(exc) == "every visible worker GPU must be a Tesla T4"
else:
    raise AssertionError("RTX inventory unexpectedly accepted")
for name, cuda in (("CFDSDFWaterLily", False), ("CFDSDFWaterLilyT4", True)):
    path = Path("julia") / name
    project = tomllib.loads((path / "Project.toml").read_text())
    manifest = tomllib.loads((path / "Manifest.toml").read_text())
    assert ("CUDA" in project["deps"]) is cuda
    assert ("CUDA" in manifest["deps"]) is cuda
    assert "JLD2" not in manifest["deps"]
    assert manifest["deps"]["WaterLily"][0]["version"] == "1.8.0"
assignments = {}
for node in ast.parse(Path("src/cfd_harness/campaign_schema.py").read_text()).body:
    if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and isinstance(node.targets[0], ast.Name) and node.targets[0].id == "GPU_EXPECTED":
        assignments["GPU_EXPECTED"] = ast.literal_eval(node.value)
assert assignments["GPU_EXPECTED"]["visible_gpu_names"] == ["Tesla T4"]
print("PASS: T4 positive / RTX negative controls; project, Manifest and GPU_EXPECTED contracts")
